headline: Rubfila International submits structural digital database compliance certificate
summary: Rubfila International has submitted its compliance certificate regarding the structural digital database for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This filing is a routine regulatory requirement under SEBI regulations for listed companies. Retail investors generally do not need to take any action based on this standard disclosure.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no direct impact on stock price

headline: Rubfila confirms SEBI dematerialisation compliance for Q2
summary: Rubfila International has officially confirmed its compliance with SEBI regulations regarding the dematerialisation of shares for the September quarter. This filing ensures the company meets the mandatory standards set by the market regulator for electronic shareholding. The confirmation provides transparency for shareholders regarding the company's adherence to corporate governance norms. No further operational changes were announced alongside this regulatory update.
why_it_matters: Ensures continued regulatory standing for the company's shareholders.
